description:
Title: Internship

You can enter a topic that interests you, and how much money you want.
You can also enter experience and hobbies.
Several offers will arrive (at arbitrary points in time).
You can accept or deny offers.
As soon as an offer is accepted, all other offers become invalid.
You have to write at least 3 status updates about your internship (every week).
The company has to write 3 status updates about you.
After the internship is finished you can recommend the company to a list of friends (via twitter).
Separate tweets are sent in parallel.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/internship">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Offer" name="Internship offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Acceptance" name="Offer acceptance"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Denial" name="Offer denial"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Internship">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_You" name="You" processRef="Process_You"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_Company"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offer" name="Offer" sourceRef="Task_SendOffer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer" messageRef="Message_Offer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Acceptance" name="Acceptance" sourceRef="Task_AcceptOffer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAcceptance" messageRef="Message_Acceptance"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Denial" name="Denial" sourceRef="Task_DenyOffer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDenial" messageRef="Message_Denial"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_You" name="Internship" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_You" name="Begin"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_EnterDetailsSplit" name="Enter internship details"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterTopicAndMoney" name="Enter topic and desired amount"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterExperienceAndHobbies" name="Enter experience and hobbies"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_EnterDetailsJoin" name="Details entered"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffer" name="Receive an offer" messageRef="Message_Offer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OfferDecision" name="Accept or deny offer" default="Flow_Deny"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_AcceptOffer" name="Accept offer" messageRef="Message_Acceptance"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DenyOffer" name="Deny offer" messageRef="Message_Denial"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_WeeklyUpdates" name="Write at least 3 weekly internship status updates">
      <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
        <bpmn:loopCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The internship is ongoing or fewer than 3 updates have been written; write one update every week.</bpmn:loopCondition>
      </bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinishInternship" name="Finish internship"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Recommend" name="Recommend the company?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SendTweets" name="Send a recommendation tweet to a friend via Twitter">
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false">
        <bpmn:loopCardinality xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Number of friends in the list</bpmn:loopCardinality>
      </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Tweets" name="Recommendation tweets sent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NoRecommendation" name="Internship finished without a recommendation"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_1" sourceRef="Start_You" targetRef="Gateway_EnterDetailsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_2" sourceRef="Gateway_EnterDetailsSplit" targetRef="Task_EnterTopicAndMoney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_3" sourceRef="Gateway_EnterDetailsSplit" targetRef="Task_EnterExperienceAndHobbies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_4" sourceRef="Task_EnterTopicAndMoney" targetRef="Gateway_EnterDetailsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_5" sourceRef="Task_EnterExperienceAndHobbies" targetRef="Gateway_EnterDetailsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_6" sourceRef="Gateway_EnterDetailsJoin" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_7" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffer" targetRef="Gateway_OfferDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accept" name="Accept" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="Task_AcceptOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The offer is accepted</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deny" name="Deny" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="Task_DenyOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_8" sourceRef="Task_DenyOffer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_9" sourceRef="Task_AcceptOffer" targetRef="Task_WeeklyUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_10" sourceRef="Task_WeeklyUpdates" targetRef="Task_FinishInternship"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_11" sourceRef="Task_FinishInternship" targetRef="Gateway_Recommend"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Recommend" name="Recommend" sourceRef="Gateway_Recommend" targetRef="Task_SendTweets">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">A recommendation is chosen</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoRecommendation" name="Do not recommend" sourceRef="Gateway_Recommend" targetRef="End_NoRecommendation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_You_12" sourceRef="Task_SendTweets" targetRef="End_Tweets"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Company" name="Company activities" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Company" name="Begin"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendOffer" name="Send an offer at an arbitrary time" messageRef="Message_Offer"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_CompanyResponse" name="Wait for offer response"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveAcceptance" name="Receive acceptance" messageRef="Message_Acceptance"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDenial" name="Receive denial" messageRef="Message_Denial"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InvalidateOffers" name="Invalidate all other offers"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WriteCompanyUpdates" name="Write 3 status updates about the intern">
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="true">
        <bpmn:loopCardinality xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">3</bpmn:loopCardinality>
      </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Company" name="Company status updates written"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_1" sourceRef="Start_Company" targetRef="Task_SendOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_2" sourceRef="Task_SendOffer" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_3" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyResponse" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAcceptance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_4" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyResponse" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDenial"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_5" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDenial" targetRef="Task_SendOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_6" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveAcceptance" targetRef="Task_InvalidateOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_7" sourceRef="Task_InvalidateOffers" targetRef="Task_WriteCompanyUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_8" sourceRef="Task_WriteCompanyUpdates" targetRef="End_Company"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
